decided: Owner (Aakash Setty), 23 October 2026: intubation medications and steps are not graded in the debrief summary. The decision to intubate stays graded where a case teaches it. What these actions do to the patient (flags, vital effects, phase changes, prerequisites) is unchanged. docs/case-authoring-requirements.md 6.3 and 22.2.
ungraded_note: Catalog ids. RSI drugs, the steps before the tube and the care after it. A case-only action that is intubation care (a hidden sedation target, a ventilator-settings action) carries "ungraded": true in the case instead.
intubation_actions_note: The decision to intubate. Graded where the case tags it. A follow-up triggered by one of these is post-intubation care and must carry "graded": false.
